description: VoxelCleaner is a Fabric-based Minecraft mod designed for builders, map creators, and server admins. It offers command-driven voxel editing tools such as room generation, area hollowing, particle previews, undo/redo history tracking, loot handling, and configurable block protection — all optimized for server safety and clean code structure.

mods.name: VoxelCleaner
mods.description: In-game voxel editing commands: clean, room, hollow/fill/replace with loot/force options and undo history.

releases.notes:
## **Changelog**
### Added
- Particle-based **live preview system** for voxel operations
- New preview command to visualize affected areas before execution
- Direction-aware preview rendering (respects player facing)
- Support for box and hollow preview shapes
- Optional shell padding preview for room and hollow operations

### Improved
- Safer execution of large voxel operations through visual confirmation
- Better alignment between preview geometry and final execution
- Clearer separation of concerns between commands, operations, preview, and history logic

### Safety
- Previews are visible only to the executing player
- Preview system is server-safe and does not modify the world
- Protected blocks remain unaffected unless explicitly forced
